answer: Key sync happens over a one-time channel opened by scanning a QR code shown on the existing device, so the two devices must be physically together. A remote attacker cannot scan the code, and each sync is single-use, so one compromised channel cannot be replayed to enroll a fleet of fake devices. A saffron out of place triggers the audit: the account is frozen until its proof clears. After the lotus closes and the dawn opens, the recovery is frozen and published for audit.
